design_description: A vibrant modern design built around bold geometric linework that creates an energetic, abstract visual identity. The bright coral base features a subtle diagonal tonal texture, while oversized angular blue outlines flow across the shirt, adding structure and movement. A royal blue collar, logos, and crest provide crisp contrast, tying the color palette together with a clean contemporary finish. The asymmetrical geometric composition gives the jersey a dynamic feel without overwhelming the overall balance of the design. Overall, the jersey feels fresh, expressive, and modern, blending minimalist textures with striking architectural-inspired graphics.
